1.bug_scenario:
The issue is that the default Carbon 10 <Tag> component renders at 24px tall (16px font-size + 4px vertical padding), which is too tall for a compact/short row (18px) in a DataTable or small Search field. In the provided screenshots you can see:  
• “Current tag (24px)”—the default Tag at 24px height, which overflows a compact row  
• “Short tag (18px)”—the proposed variant at 18px total height (8px horizontal padding, 1px top/bottom padding), which fits inside a compact 18px row height
